sourceDescription: Author-owned board routing checkpoint, captured before joint DRC exact repair; contributed under this repository MIT license.
adaptations: Preserve all captured obstacle geometry, routes, net aliases, and solver budgets.

Assign pcb_smtpad_fixed_<original obstacle index> aliases to fixed-copper rectangles that lack pad/port IDs, so the native repair DRC includes them without the autorouter-specific fixed-copper callback. These rectangles represent fixed copper, not actual component pads.
Omit nonserializable autorouter DRC callbacks; use the native DRC engine. Enable the standalone contact guard (deferTraceContactGuard=false).
observed: Input clears actual pad but intersects expanded obstacle; published repair crosses actual pad. This is worsening of an existing obstacle-pair violation, not a new obstacle pair.
